############################################################################################################
#	WA AI LANDING - scripted-invasion target-reservation data
#
#	GENERATED FILE - do not hand-edit. Regenerate with:
#	    python tools/gen/gen_ai_landing_reservations.py
#	Sources: WA_KDE_AI_effects.txt (calendar) + events/WA_AI_invasions.txt (anchor states).
#	Consumers: WA_AI_LANDING_update_reservations (WA_AI_LANDING_effects.txt).
#
#	WA_AI_LANDING_op_anchor^i  anchor state of operation i (its CONTROLLER at pulse time is the
#	                           reservation target - dynamic, never a stored tag)
#	WA_AI_LANDING_op_expiry^i  last pending day, as days since 1936.1.1 (fire date + 45 grace)
#	Compared against global.num_days - global.WA_AI_LANDING_epoch (epoch set at startup).
#
#	Tag scopes below are DATA, not gating: this file is the generated mirror of the tag-keyed
#	KDE calendar (same standing as common/ai_faction_theaters). Rule 2 archetype triggers do
#	not apply to a calendar that is itself per-country.
############################################################################################################
